title: Integration rotations and risks log - 2026-12-15
summary: Weekly standup focused on active customer integrations, rotation of on-call SEs, immediate blockers for Dedicated/private rollouts, and triage of two incidents. Primary actions: update autoscale profile for Nimbus Retail, complete security questionnaire for AcuityBank, and schedule a canary window for Orchid Health.
metrics_snapshot: End-to-end latencies: median 95ms (text gen), p99 480ms; error rate 0.7% (spike during A/B rollout window); Dedicated capacity utilization average 78%; KV cache hit rate 64%. Nimbus Retail observed higher 99th percentile for short sequences (700ms) during checkout traffic spikes.
body:
Attendees: Aisha (SE lead), Marco (field eng), Sofia (proservices PM), Darnell (SRE liaison), Yuna (security), + customer leads joining for blocks.

Agenda:
- Quick health check across active integrations
- Rotation and on-call coverage for SEs over holiday week
- Open blockers and escalations (security, infra, performance)
- Action item review from last week
- New risks and mitigation plan

Notes and per-customer status:
1) Orchid Health (pilot, small clinical deployment)
- Current phase: end-to-end smoke tests passed, scheduling canary for 12/18 09:00-11:00PT.
- Open: EHR-integration webhook retries causing duplicate submissions in staging (race on ack path). Marco investigating retry backoff; tentative fix is to add idempotency key on connector (PR GH#3421).
- Security: Yuna confirmed scope of pen test is agreed; waiting on third-party tester availability (ETA 12/21).
- Risk: Clinical privacy requires proof of no PHI leakage in logs; action to scrub structured logs during canary.

2) Nimbus Retail (Dedicated pool for BFCM-style surge support)
- Current phase: capacity sizing and autoscale profile tuning. Observed increased p99 for short sequences during simulated checkout bursts.
- Root cause hypothesis: aggressive batching at gateway + slow kernel path for short sequences. Darnell suggested adjusting batching thresholds for dedicated pool.
- Action: Update autoscale/batching config to prefer lower latency (smaller batch max_tokens) for checkout route by 12/17. Jira JIRA-INT-10017 created.
- Commercial: Customer requested SLA for 99th percentile by end of Quarter; need SRE confirmation on commit.

3) AcuityBank (private deployment, regulatory review)
- Current phase: SOC equivalent checklist in progress; customer legal issued supplemental questionnaire with items around KMS rotation and HSM integration.
- Action: Yuna to deliver answers + config snippets by 12/18; proservices to run DEPLOY-PRIV-02 checklist once answers accepted.
- Blocker: On-prem vendor needs a signed flow-down on encryption key escrow; legal to follow up (Sofia).

4) Triton Analytics (hosted -> dedicated migration)
- Current phase: data migration dry-run scheduled 12/20.
- Concern: model variant mapping mismatch (two custom-tokenizer variants). Team to run compatibility test and prepare fallback policy.
- Action: Aisha to produce migration runbook and rollback steps by 12/17.

Incidents and triage:
- Incident 12/12 spike: A/B rollout to refine reranking model caused a 0.9% error bump for 30 minutes. Root cause: incomplete protobuf interface for new scoring field. Fix shipped and rollout reversed; postmortem draft in CONFLUENCE-1423.
- Note: adjust QA gates for interface changes (add contract-tests to CI) to prevent silent mismatches.

Operational notes:
- SE rotations: Holiday week coverage changes. Marco on primary pager 12/24-12/28; Darnell covers infra escalation. Yuna on security standby for regulatory questions. Please update on-call in PagerDuty.
- Canary windows: Prefer mornings PT for minimum traffic — coordinate with customer PMs and SRE.
- Rollouts: Use canary + automated rollback policy for any model change touching production reranking/ltr.

Decisions captured (also listed below):
- Defer Nimbus SLA commit until after autoscale re-test next week.
- Add contract-tests for protobuf schemas to the integration CI pipeline.

Open blockers and asks:
- Legal: expedite key escrow flow-down for AcuityBank (Sofia).
- Infra: prioritize short-sequence kernel tweak on dedicated nodes for Nimbus (Darnell).
- Dev: PR GH#3421 (idempotency on connector) needs review before canary for Orchid.

Next steps / near-term timeline:
- 12/17: Autoscale and batching changes staged for Nimbus; load test 12/17 afternoon.
- 12/18: Orchid canary window 09:00-11:00PT; ensure scrubbed logs.
- 12/20: Triton migration dry-run.
- 12/21: Pen test for Orchid (if third-party available).

Tone and informal notes:
- Several quick Slack threads popped up during the incident; please prefer ticketing for any config change that impacts SLOs.
- Notes-to-self: add a short baked-in checklist for "short-sequence latency" tuning to the Platform Runbook (I/O: batching thresholds, kernel flags, quantization profile).
action_items: Marco: finish idempotency PR GH#3421 and request review (due 2026-12-16)
Darnell: stage autoscale/batching config for Nimbus and run load test (due 2026-12-17)
Yuna: complete and send AcuityBank security questionnaire answers (due 2026-12-18)
Aisha: publish Triton migration runbook + rollback steps (due 2026-12-17)
Sofia: coordinate legal with customer for key escrow flow-down (due 2026-12-18)
SE team: enable protobuf contract-tests in integration CI (owner: eng-infra, due 2027-01-07)
decisions: Defer Nimbus SLA commit until autoscale re-test completes
Require contract-tests for protobuf schema changes before rolling to production
parking_lot: Investigate long-term KV cache eviction strategy for multi-tenant dedicated pools
Define standardized canary checklist (ops + security + customer comms)
Add 'short-sequence latency' tuning section to runbook
